messages:
zoe: Quick doc bug: POST /v1/generate examples show response as "choices" array. Runtime returns "output". This breaks the JS and curl examples.

li: Thanks Zoe. Where is the example file?

zoe: content/api/generate.md and snippets under site/_snippets/generate_examples.yaml. I repro with staging: response contains output:[{text,...}].

pat: Simple fix: update example payloads and param table to `max_new_tokens`. Add a short migration note for `max_tokens`.

li: I'll update the markdown and regenerate snippets. Also add a unit test that validates examples match response schema to prevent regressions.

docs-bot: docs-ci: example-validation failed for content/api/generate.md (schema mismatch). Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/5678 :x:

zoe: For the example, use this minimal pair:
Request:
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"redwood/fast-1","max_new_tokens":48,"prompt":"Define memoization"}
Response:
{"id":"g_1","model":"redwood/fast-1","output":[{"text":"Memoization is...","type":"text"}]}

pat: Will push a patch and ping reviewers. Also add a note in the SDK snippets: raw HTTP uses `max_new_tokens`; SDK helpers will accept `max_tokens` but are deprecated.

li: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1100. Request reviewers.

zoe: Thanks! After merge, can someone post a short heads-up in #support?

pat: Sure, will post a blurb and link to the PR.
